device_faults.rule: fault = 0x8007001F (device_error) / unreleasable or hung reader / streaming command killed at its timeout; its streaming commands are gated from the next test on; each later test re-probes it once (1-frame MF capture) and un-faults it if it answers

measurements.note: cameras and modes run one at a time; default mode first, low-rate modes last; fps_steady skips the first 15% of frames; 8 frames decoded per mode, spread across the capture
